name: HariOm Refund Policy Demo
description: A 6-item demo dataset about a fictional refund policy for the TRACE AI hackathon demo.

corpus.title: Refund Timeline Policy
corpus.text: All refund requests are processed within 30 business days of receipt. Customers must submit their refund requests through the official portal. Incomplete requests may extend processing time.

corpus.title: Refund Eligibility
corpus.text: To be eligible for a refund, customers must have made their purchase within the last 90 days. The item must be in its original condition and packaging. Digital products are non-refundable once downloaded.

corpus.title: Return Shipping
corpus.text: Customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the item is defective. HariOm provides a prepaid label for defective items. The cost of return shipping is deducted from the refund amount for non-defective returns.

corpus.title: Refund Methods
corpus.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Credit card refunds take 5-10 additional business days to appear on statements after HariOm processes the refund. Bank transfer refunds may take up to 3 business days.

corpus.title: Partial Refunds
corpus.text: Partial refunds may be issued for items that are returned in used condition. The refund amount is determined based on the degree of use and any damage to the item. A minimum restocking fee of 15% applies to all partial refunds.

corpus.title: Customer Support
corpus.text: For questions about refunds, customers can contact our support team at support@hariom.example. Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST. Response times are typically within 24 hours.
